part.text:
Fixed the XTRIM MINID bug in `src/t_stream.c:800`.

The ID deltas read from the listpack were stored in 32-bit `int`, truncating large millisecond deltas and causing all entries to compare below the threshold. They are now `int64_t`.

Validated with the full `unit/type/stream` suite: all tests pass, including `XTRIM with MINID option, big delta from master record`.
